title: Bitclub Network - Iceland Bitcoin Mining Facility Tour 2017
description: Earn Bitcoin Daily with BitClub Network! Start Cryptocurrency and Bitcoin Mining today, and secure yourself a daily passive ...

asr.full_text: Music Right we just got to Iceland, we're really excited invited about 200 of our friends to fly on out to come check out our data centers We got a couple of buses here, we're gonna pack everyone in Go check out the data center, the Bitcoin mine where we process All these Bitcoin and Blockchain transactions around the world And then we're gonna have a big lunch and then we're gonna head up to Blue Lagoon Music transactions around the world. And then, we're going to have a big lunch. Then we're going to head up the Blue Lagoon. Hey guys, I'm G-Live from Malaysia. My name is Laurie Warshaw. I live in San Diego, California. My name is Mike. I'm from Calgary, Canada. Well, my name is Joi Zervoulakis. I am from Tupuo Island on Guam. Hey there, this is Kevin Topino. I am in Reykjavik Iceland. And what's going on is Bitcoin, baby. To be honest with you. I'm super-excited and fired up. I am fortunate enough to be part of the Bit Club network, which means I mine Bitcoin. Been living on Bitcoin since November 26, 2014. You're either the needle or the thread. Get on the bus! So, we just made it into the data center, we just had our tour, just check out all of our equipment. We've got lots of team members with us and it's pretty exciting to actually see all of the machines at work, 24-7 right here in Iceland. This is an ant miner. This is the s5, when we started it was s3s, s5s, s7s to s9s. So this tech keeps getting faster and the chip smaller and more efficient. I think this is the 28 nanometer chip. We now have 16 nanometer chips. And by the time you guys are watching this, we might even have like 10 nanometer chip. So it gets smaller, faster, more efficient, less electricity. And these things just crank away. There's thousands and thousands of these things in this data center here. And as you can see, you got to have a fan because it creates a lot of heat. But this is basically it. This is a machine that prints money. Literally, this is a machine that prints money in the form of Bitcoin. It helps us process all the Bitcoin and blockchain transactions of all around the world, it all happens here So it turned out to be a pretty successful day we made it to the data center with about 200 people, then four buses full and the weather turned out to be pretty awesome! Great lunch, and everyone's so excited! Iceland, I'd say, was a home run. Now it's off to New Hampshire to block fest! I'll see you in New York .

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BitClub Network participation by presenting member-owned Bitcoin mining equipment as a way to earn Bitcoin daily and generate passive income. The description explicitly advertises daily earnings, while the video calls the mining machine a machine that prints money and showcases equipment associated with individual members. The supplied content does not show a completed loss or establish the exact purchase terms, but its main communicative action is promotional solicitation for paid mining participation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the video links recurring Bitcoin income and passive daily earnings to a mining operation whose machines are presented as owned by individual members. The evidence supports promotion of paid or member-based mining participation, without sufficient evidence for a tiered recruitment structure or credential request.
